subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Season and occasion for which clothing is worn (winter/summer washing line, party outfits)

show.line: In summer it is hot. In winter it is cold. We wear different clothes!

rounds.prompt: Summer or winter clothes? Sort them.
It is cold outside. What do you wear?
It is a hot day. What do you wear?
rounds.praise: A sunhat keeps the sun off.

rounds.prompt: It is a party! Which outfit is for a party?
What do you wear to bed?

rounds.story: It is snowing in the mountains. Thandi goes outside to play. What should she wear?

hints: Hot weather: light clothes. Cold weather: warm clothes.
Think: will I be too hot or too cold?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! It is a cold winter day.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will wear shorts and sandals!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! In winter I need a jersey and a beanie.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Winter is cold. Jersey, beanie and scarf!

parent_line: Can choose clothes for hot, cold and special days.
